parole.testo: Borrowed from obsolete Italian meschita, from Spanish mezquita, from Andalusian Arabic, from Arabic مَسْجِد (masjid, “mosque”, literally “place of prostration”), from the verbal root سَجَدَ (sajada, “to prostrate, bow down”).

parole.significato: chocolate (food made from ground roasted cocoa beans)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Italian cioccolata, from Spanish chocolate. First attested in the 17th century.
